_comment: Repositories that must never be published on spielkunst. Each one was vendored and rejected: the published page is a landing page rather than a game, the game needs a build step (webpack, vite, emscripten) and can never run in a browser, or the entry file asks a host outside spielkunst for something the site's Content-Security-Policy refuses. The harvest pipeline skips them, so they cannot come back on the next run. `notes` carries the file, line and URL behind each new rejection so a reviewer can check it without reopening the repository.

notes.luleoa12/wordle_craft: The daily answer comes from a third-party API: script.js:193 fetch(`https://wordle-craft.luleoa12.workers.dev?datetime=...`). index.html also pulls html2canvas from html2canvas.hertzen.com (line 614), Google Tag Manager (line 623) and Google Fonts (line 53). The site's CSP is connect-src 'self' / script-src 'self' (public/_headers), so the word never arrives and there is nothing to guess.
notes.ramazancetinkaya/snake-game: The external stylesheet is what labels the interface: index.html:15 loads Font Awesome 6.6.0 from cdnjs and the five header buttons are icon-only, so with style-src 'self' they render blank. Its page title 'Snake Game' is also already used by motasimmakki-snake-game-in-javascript.
notes.StarKnightt/operation-ironhold: index.html:396 loads three.js r128 from cdnjs and the repository holds no local copy of the engine, so script-src 'self' leaves an empty page. Everything the game draws goes through that one script.
notes.timdream/wordcloud2.js: index.html is the library's demo/configurator, not a game: it is a form of width, height, mask and option fields that renders a word cloud. It loads jQuery from ajax.googleapis.com (line 14) and bootstrap from cdnjs (line 15), both refused by script-src 'self'.
notes.bocaletto-luca/Guess-The-Flag: index.html is an identity hub, not a game: author links to bocalettoluca.altervista.org, bocaletto-luca.github.io, github.com/bocaletto-luca/, facebook.com/people/Luca-Bocaletto, youtube.com/@Elektronoide and soundcloud.com/luca-bocaletto, a wall of technology icons, and one 'Gioca' button. The quiz behind the button (game.html) boots with $('#playerModal').modal({...}) at main.js:16 using jQuery from code.jquery.com, so under script-src 'self' the DOMContentLoaded handler throws before the start button is wired, and it posts scores to save.php/records.php, which static hosting cannot run.
notes.Ninja1375/invasores-espaciais: One missing asset: style.css:3 declares @font-face with url("Play-Regular.ttf") and the vendored tree has no font file at all (index.html, script.js, style.css, README, LICENSE only). The browser probe returns [http 404] /third-party/ninja1375-invasores-espaciais/Play-Regular.ttf. The game itself paints and has on-screen controls, so this entry can be removed as soon as the font is vendored next to style.css or the @font-face block is dropped.
notes.awslabs/the-qubit-factory: Entry page loads scripts/PopWindow.js, SpeechDump.js, Achievements.js and LevelConsts.js, none of which exist in the repository (checked 2026-10-30) - the game boots to a blank canvas. No build step is documented that would produce them.
notes.LongSteve/aquastax: index.html loads js/cocos2d-js-v3.15-min.js and frameworks/cocos2d-html5/CCBoot.js; neither file is in the repository, so the engine never loads. Upstream ships the source of the engine, not a browser build.
notes.AdemCanCertel-zz/electron-canvas-game: index.html loads js/index.js, which the repository does not contain (it is an Electron desktop project with no web build committed). Blank page under static hosting.
notes.futrime/game-of-life: index.html loads my_collection.js, absent from the repository; nothing renders.
notes.motasimmakki/Snake-Game-in-JavaScript: snakeGame.html loads a local jQuery.js that is not committed and falls back to code.jquery.com, which the site CSP (script-src self) blocks - the page cannot boot.
notes.benruijl/justone: Multiplayer-only: include/index.html:358 opens `ws://` + location.host + `/chat`. A static host serves no WebSocket endpoint, so the page cannot start a game - the smoke gate sees the failed handshake on every visit.
notes.Omar-Mazen/weatherio: Needs a live third-party API and a key: assest/js/api.js:13 calls api.openweathermap.org with `appid=${apiKey}`. The site CSP is connect-src self, so every request is refused and the page has nothing to show.
notes.richie-rich90454/hackathon-game: A Tauri + Go desktop project: the vendored tree holds src/, src-tauri/ and public/ with no built entry, so the module script the page asks for is served as application/octet-stream and the page dies on the MIME check. Needs a vite build.
notes.minecraft8997/mclordchess-frontend: Multiplayer-only client: it opens ws://<host>:5557/socket, which a static host cannot serve - connection refused on every visit.
notes.avokadoen/tetris-wasm: The page dynamically imports www/index.js and the repository does not contain it (only the C sources), so the import 404s and the frame stays blank.
notes.s2031215/pixijs-solitaire: The entry page asks for a script that is not in the repository (404 on load); nothing renders.
